subject: website
name: Horswap
summary: Dark Florist's fork of the Uniswap interface. Its source is public (GPL-3.0) and the repository names this CID. It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: it reads chain data from RPC endpoints without a light client and fetches token lists from GitHub, CoinGecko, Gemini and IPFS gateways when it opens.

connections.name: Ethereum RPC (ethereum.keydonix.com, cloudflare-eth.com)
connections.note: Chain reads when the page opens, without a light client.

connections.name: Token lists (CoinGecko, GitHub, Gemini, Arbitrum, Optimism, Celo)
IPFS gateways (ipfs.io, gateway.ipfs.io, cloudflare-ipfs.com)
connections.note: Used to fetch token list data.
